red.$description: Brand red for large brand surfaces, logo grounds and decorative emphasis. Not a fill for small white text; use color.action.primary.bg.

yellow.$description: Promotional yellow for offer blocks and campaign panels. Always pair with color.text.primary.

canvas.$description: Default page and card background. White surfaces carry product photography.

subtle.$description: Quiet neutral background for chips, table headers and grouped regions.

inverse.$description: Dark background for ink buttons, badges, utility bars and photo panels.

primary.$description: Headings, body copy and labels on color.surface.canvas, color.surface.subtle and color.brand.yellow.

secondary.$description: Supporting paragraphs on color.surface.canvas and color.surface.subtle.

muted.$description: Product details, field notes and captions on color.surface.canvas and color.surface.subtle.

inverse.$description: Text on color.surface.inverse and on photography protected by color.overlay.

default.$description: Decorative dividers and table rules. Not a control boundary.

control.$description: Input, select, swatch and secondary-button boundaries (3:1 on canvas).

bg.$description: Primary button fill under white labels.

text.$description: Label on primary action fills in every state.

hover.$description: Primary button fill on hover; also link hover color.

focus.$description: Focus outline: 2px solid with a 3px offset on every interactive recipe.

text.$description: Product code label text on color.code.bg.

previous.$description: Struck-through previous price and its “Antes” label.

inverse.$description: Price on photography protected by color.overlay or a dark area.

text.$description: Error text and invalid-field borders on color.status.danger.bg and canvas.

overlay.$description: Gradient scrim behind text on photography. Validate each final crop.
